description: Boundary-aligned flow-port assets. Incoming and outgoing faces are independent roles; old head anchor is not a mandatory input. Integrated by PipeModels using the generated pipe-models.json lookup.
rotationConvention: right-handed; +X=east,+Y=up,+Z=south; targetPoint = pivot + matrix * (basePoint-pivot); quaternion order x,y,z,w; whole-model UV rotates with geometry
